requirements.heading: Format of a Message Tracking Status Notification
requirements.text: The actual body MUST be a multipart/related [RFC-RELATED] with type parameter of "message/tracking-status"; each subpart MUST be of type "message/tracking-status" as described herein.

requirements.heading: The message/tracking-status content-type
requirements.text: MIME type name: message MIME subtype name: tracking-status Optional parameters: none Encoding considerations: "7bit" encoding is sufficient and MUST be used to maintain readability when viewed by non-MIME mail readers.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: This field MUST be present for each recipient named in the MTSN.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: No further information is available; in particular, the tracking agent SHOULD NOT attempt further "downstream" tracking requests.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: However, these additional addresses are not trackable, and the tracking agent SHOULD NOT attempt further "downstream" tracking requests.

requirements.heading: Action field
requirements.text: The tracking agent SHOULD attempt further "downstream" tracking requests unless that information is already given in a chaining response.

requirements.heading: Status field
requirements.text: A 2.1.9 Status field MUST be used exclusively with a "relayed" Action field.

requirements.heading: Remote-MTA field
requirements.text: This field MUST NOT be included if no delivery attempts have been made or if the Action field has value "opaque".

requirements.heading: Remote-MTA field
requirements.text: If delivery to some agent other than an MTA (for example, a Local Delivery Agent) then this field MAY be included, giving the name of the host on which that agent was contacted.

requirements.heading: Last-Attempt-Date field
requirements.text: This field is REQUIRED if any delivery attempt has been made and the Action field does not have value "opaque", in which case it will specify when it last attempted to deliver this message to another MTA or other Delivery Agent.

requirements.heading: Last-Attempt-Date field
requirements.text: This field MUST NOT be included if no delivery attempts have been made.

requirements.heading: Will-Retry-Until field
requirements.text: If the message is not in the local queue or the Action field has the value "opaque" the Will-Retry-Until field MUST NOT be included; otherwise, this field SHOULD be included.

requirements.heading: Interaction Between MTAs and LDAs
requirements.text: A message that has been delivered to a Local Delivery Agent (LDA) that understands message tracking (in particular, an LDA speaking LMTP [RFC-LMTP] that supports the MTRK extension) SHOULD pass the tracking request to the LDA.

requirements.heading: Confidentiality
requirements.text: The tracking algorithms MUST NOT allow tracking through list expansions.

requirements.heading: Confidentiality
requirements.text: When a message is delivered to a list, a tracking request MUST respond with an "expanded" tracking status and MUST NOT display the contents of the list.
